Work independently, enjoy plenty of freedom, and hit the road every day? Become a Delivery Driver Jumbo in Nieuwegein through Consolid and start working at Jumbo right away. Wat bieden wij? €17.75 gross per hour from the age of 21, including holiday pay, additional statutory leave, and ADV allowance; 50% extra pay for working between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM; 100% extra pay on public holidays; 20 vacation days per year based on a full-time contract of 40 hours per week; Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre from 10.1 km up to a maximum of 35 km one-way; Pension accrual after 8 weeks of employment; Meal allowance for late shifts; Flexible work schedule between 12 and 35 hours per week; A high level of independence during your working day; Driving a modern and fully equipped Jumbo delivery van; Opportunities to work part-time or full-time; Career development opportunities within Jumbo and Consolid; Prospect of a permanent contract with Jumbo; Attractive referral bonus when you introduce a new colleague. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Jumbo | Flexible Shifts | Utrecht Region Start your working day at the Jumbo Hub in Nieuwegein. Together with your colleagues, you review the schedule, prepare your route, and load your delivery van with grocery orders. Then you head out independently to deliver groceries to customers throughout the Utrecht region. As a Delivery Driver, you are one of the faces of Jumbo. You deliver groceries safely, on time, and with a friendly attitude. You assist customers when needed, answer questions, and make sure every delivery is completed with care. Thanks to your service, customers can count on a great delivery experience. No two working days are the same. You will drive different routes, visit a variety of locations, and meet many different customers throughout the day. After completing your route, you return to the hub and finish your shift together with you

colleagues. What does a typical working day look like? You start at the Jumbo Hub in Nieuwegein, check your route, and head out in a modern delivery van. During your shift, you deliver groceries to customers throughout the Utrecht region. Do I need experience? Previous delivery experience is not required. However, you must have held a valid Category B driving licence (manual transmission) for at least 6 months and enjoy providing excellent customer service. Can I work part-time? Yes, you can work either part-time or full-time. You are available for at least 2 days per week, and your schedule is based on the availability you provide. Working hours: Flexible shifts between 6:00 AM and 11:00 PM; Flexible work schedule between 12 and 35 hours per week; Available at least 2 days per week; Available to work at least 1 Saturday every 2 weeks; Planning based on your availability. High-tech machinery, daytime shifts and plenty of opportunities. A role with perspective, a competitive salary, and the space to develop yourself. Wie zoeken we? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building you are accurate, practical and quality-oriented. You understand better than anyone how important it is that every machine delivers exactly what the customer requires. You work independently or together with colleagues on assembling and testing complex modules and systems. You solve problems quickly and proactively, and you naturally enjoy supporting your colleagues and sharing your knowledge. Technicial background or education Interest in fine mechanics and precision work Accuracy and strong attention to detail Good command of English and the ability to follow instructions Wat bieden wij je? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building, you can of course expect something in return for your efforts. You will have a varied role in daytime shifts within a dedicated team of specialists. There is plenty of room for development, training, and career growth. In addition, you will work in a pleasant, informal environment with opportunities for team activities. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.200 based on a 40-hour week A one-year contract with the client, with prospects for a permanent position 27 vacation days and 13 additional days off Participation in the PME pension fund (Metalektro) Informal working atmosphere with opportunities for team activities Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician in high-tech machine building you will assemble and test advanced machines used for wafer processing with plasma technology. These machines are essential to the semiconductor industry, a vital sector powering the technology behind everything from smartphones and medical devices to cars, smart appliances and sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a cleanroom environment. Depending on the size of the machine you will either handle th

build independently or together with one or two colleagues. While some standard machines are delivered, no two machines are ever the same since each one is fully customized to the client’s specifications. Once you know the machines inside out you will also perform the final testing and prepare the accompanying test reports, making sure the machines deliver exactly as promised. This is a highly responsible role as you will be working with precision equipment. You will also support less experienced colleagues, contributing directly to the team and the quality of the machines. Your work makes an immediate difference in the performance of these products. Assembling high-tech machines and components in a cleanroom environment Testing and inspecting the functionality of the systems Identifying and resolving technical issues during the assembly process Adapting machines to meet specific customer requirements and needs Where will you be working? You will join an innovative company in the semiconductor industry, based in Nijmegen. This high-tech organisation develops and builds machines for the global market, with locations in Europe, China and the United States. The production department in Nijmegen consists of around 20 colleagues who share a passion for technology. The atmosphere is informal and supportive – you are never on your own. Ready to take the next step as an assembly technician in high-tech? Apply today and we will get in touch with you soon.
